data.name: Little Drone TuTuTu
data.detailed_description:
Little Drone TuTuTu is a top-down twin-stick roguelite shooter about a tiny drone, an unreasonable amount of firepower, and a research facility that is about to have a very long day. Arm the drone past common sense, enter one room, and keep shooting until the room stops having opinions.

CLEAR THE ROOM. SOMEHOW.

Each run sends you through a chain of lab areas packed with enemy fire, multi-wave assaults, objectives, and bosses that would strongly prefer you left. Dodge what you can, survive the rest, grab an upgrade, and head deeper before the facility finishes the incident report.

BUILD SOMETHING IRRESPONSIBLE

Fill four action slots: Primary, Secondary, Utility, and Special. Stack Augments until your sensible little loadout becomes a screen-filling engineering violation. Mix equipment, pile on status effects, and discover combinations that probably should have required a permit. No two runs break common sense the same way.

THE FACILITY MAKES BAD DECISIONS TOO

Security grows with you. Enemies stack their own augments, pick up new behaviors, and arrive in nastier combinations. Bosses bring builds of their own. The deeper you go, the harder the facility tries to become your problem, and the more aggressively you become its problem.

  • Fast, tactile twin-stick combat: move fast, hit hard, leave very little screen visible

  • Builds that get out of hand: combine equipment, augments, and status effects until the plan becomes weather

  • Short roguelite runs: quick to restart, increasingly questionable to continue

  • More ways to overreact: unlock new equipment simply by surviving your own decisions

Arm the drone. Enter the room. Apologize to nobody.
